verdict.rationale: The changelog says the desktop app can install and run MCP connectors on your machine or local network (lobe-chat-docs-5, lobe-chat-docs-27). The docs describe Connectors as how an Agent uses a service or tool (lobe-chat-docs-60), and LobeHub lists 100k+ MCP servers "to power your Agents" (lobe-chat-docs-12), so plugging in MCP servers for tool use is a first-party capability. Evidence is limited to changelog and marketing lines, not setup docs or hands-on reports. missing for 10: in-depth docs on adding and configuring MCP servers (remote/HTTP transports, web or self-hosted versions beyond desktop), independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use working.
